Manchester United vs Manchester City: Live Stream & Watch Online

The highly anticipated Manchester Derby is set to take place as Manchester United host their fierce rivals Manchester City in a pivotal match in the England - Premier League. With both teams looking to secure vital points in the battle for supremacy in the league, this fixture promises to deliver an exhilarating encounter. As of now, Manchester United sits in third place, while Manchester City is just behind in fourth, making this match crucial for their title aspirations.

Match Preview

Both Manchester United and Manchester City come into this derby with a mix of form and determination. The Red Devils have been working under pressure from their supporters, following a series of inconsistent performances, but they have shown promise with key victories in recent weeks. Manager Erik ten Hag will be keen to leverage the home advantage at Old Trafford, where United traditionally performs strongly against their city rivals.

On the other hand, Pep Guardiola's Manchester City continues to demonstrate their attacking prowess, having dominated the league early on in the season. Despite a minor stumbling block in recent fixtures, City's depth in squad and tactical flexibility give them an edge as they seek to reclaim their top spot. This match will also mark a significant moment for Guardiola, who looks to extend his record in this storied rivalry.

Offensively, Bruno Fernandes is expected to play a pivotal role, often being the creative spark in midfield. The likes of Marcus Rashford and Anthony Martial will be crucial in converting chances into goals as they aim to put City under pressure early.

Manchester City

Manchester City boasts a resolute defense that has excelled throughout the season, anchored by Ruben Dias. Their attacking unit, led by the prolific Erling Haaland, poses a constant threat. With Kevin De Bruyne orchestrating play from midfield, City’s tactical versatility will be on full display. The only concern may be the late fitness test on Rodri, which could dictate how City sets up tactically against United's counterattacking strategy.

The upcoming clash between Tottenham Hotspur and West Ham United is not just another fixture in the England Premier League; it’s a quintessential London derby that promises high-stakes drama and intense rivalry. Both teams head into this match under the scrutiny of their passionate fan bases, with Tottenham looking to assert their dominance at home while West Ham aims to upset the odds. As the Premier League season unfolds, this matchday could be pivotal in shaping both clubs’ aspirations for European qualification and mid-table security. Kick-off: 17.01.2026, 15:00 UTC / 18:00 MSK

Match Preview

Tottenham Hotspur comes into this encounter on the back of a mixed run of form. They have shown flashes of brilliance this season but have struggled with consistency, particularly in matches against teams in the upper echelon of the league. Antonio Conte's side will be eager to capitalize on home advantage, where the atmosphere at the Tottenham Hotspur Stadium can be electrifying, especially during derbies. West Ham United, meanwhile, has demonstrated resilience in their performances, recently pulling off commendable results against some higher-ranked teams. David Moyes' tactical acumen and West Ham's well-drilled style of play make them a dangerous opponent on their day. The Hammers will seek to exploit any defensive lapses from Spurs, especially on counter-attacks and set pieces.

Tottenham Hotspur

Defensively, Spurs have shown vulnerabilities at times, particularly from crosses and during transitions. With a solid goalkeeping presence in Hugo Lloris, they still need to tighten their back line, especially with injuries plaguing their defense. The return of key players could provide a much-needed boost. Offensively, stars like Harry Kane and Heung-Min Son remain critical to their attacking strategy, providing goals and creativity. Recent injury updates suggest that some defensive stalwarts may return, bolstering their lineup ahead of this crucial derby. The attacking partnership of Kane and Son has been lethal, and if they find their rhythm, Spurs could expose any weaknesses in the West Ham defense.

West Ham United

West Ham has been solid throughout the season, demonstrating a strong defensive unit led by the ever-reliable Declan Rice in midfield. Their pressing game continues to put pressure on opponents and create turnovers, which could be key in capitalizing on Spurs' defensive errors. They also boast an attacking threat with players like Jarrod Bowen and Michail Antonio capable of causing problems. With injuries playing a role in their squad depth, Moyes will have to strategically deploy his available resources to ensure they compete effectively against a Tottenham side that can, on their day, dismantle any defense in the league.
